hooks.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q '\.tsx\?$\|\.jsx\?$\|\.json$\|\.md$\|\.css$'; then FILE_PATH=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$FILE_PATH" ] && [ -f "$FILE_PATH" ]; then npx prettier --write "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi

FILE_PATH=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if echo "$FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.tsx?$'; then echo '{"feedback": "TypeScript file modified. Consider running type check: npx tsc --noEmit"}'; fi

FILE_PATH=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if echo "$FILE_PATH" | grep -q 'supabase/migrations/'; then echo '{"feedback": "Migration file created! Remember to: 1) Apply migration to database, 2) Regenerate types: npx supabase gen types typescript --project-id PROJECT_ID > src/lib/database/types.ts, 3) Verify compilation: npx tsc --noEmit"}'; fi
